name: Confirm the customer's contact record
description: Check res.partner has a real billing email, phone, and address before anything else - this is who gets invoiced and who the portal login belongs to.

name: Confirm the sales order and what was actually purchased
description: List every product line on the order - hosting package, domain(s), VoIP/SMS, managed Odoo instance - so you know which of the other checklists in this folder apply to this customer.

name: Confirm a saved payment method exists
description: reseller_subscriptions' billing cron auto-charges from a saved payment.token - a customer with no saved card on file will silently never get billed until one exists. Check via their portal or Accounting > Customers.

name: Run the service-specific checklist(s) for what they bought
description: Import whichever of 02-07 in this folder match the order: hosting, domain registration, SignalWire VoIP, SignalWire SMS, 10DLC registration, managed Odoo instance.

name: Spot-check every provisioned service actually works
description: Log in as the customer (or ask them to) and confirm each purchased service is real and reachable, not just marked provisioned in Odoo.

name: Share portal access with the customer
description: Point them at /my/subscriptions (reseller_subscriptions' unified hub) - shows hosting, domains, VoIP/SMS, and managed instances all in one place, with self-service cancel where applicable.

name: Hold a kickoff call / send a welcome email
description: Confirm they know how to reach support, where their portal is, and what to expect on their first invoice.

name: Close out this checklist
description: Mark this project/task list done once every purchased service's own checklist is finished.
